generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: genuine painted 2D creature action atlas for original 1999 Heroes of Might and Magic III.
Input1: our independently PAINTED character identity, subject/equipment/face/colour reference ONLY. Input2: original HoMM3 monk/zealot native pixels and nearest enlargement, private rendering/camera/style reference ONLY, never copy those troops. Input3: official Noxus emblem shape reference only.
Subject: EXACT SAME Noxian crimson blood-magic ritualist as input1, full-length worn crimson hood/scarf and robes, layered brown leather straps, metal cloak clasp, three sealed red belt-vials, bare human hands, existing short sheathed belt dagger. Maintain the conspicuous IVORY NOXUS CREST on the upper chest crimson cloth: swept hooked bilateral lobes, central descending spine and negative cutouts. Crest follows actual cloth perspective and natural occlusion, not an arbitrary star/flower/skull. Keep all full costume, same proportions/materials/face and restrained upper-left light in every cell.
True original HoMM3 richly textured miniature painting, compact crisp pixels, readable matte cloth/leather/steel and deep shadow masses. Not slick CGI, not 3D render, not animation rig, not cel/vector/anime, no cinematic lighting. Slightly elevated near-frontal three-quarter camera, canonical RIGHT-facing in all normal poses, fixed scale and light. Only actual newly painted changing limb/body poses; no stretched idle copies. No third-party character identity, no added weapon, bow/gun, wings, bodymutation, companion or summoned unit.
Every whole figure including robe hem, hands and boots isolated INSIDE its own exact cell with generous transparent gutter. NO figure touches a neighbour. GENUINE TRANSPARENT alpha-zero background, no checkerboard, colour matte, labels, numbers, frames, gridlines, ground, shadowdisk or scene. Return the entire exact1536x1024 sheet.
BASE: simple worn hood/robes and modest leather/bracers, no heavy shoulder armour.
Sheet EXACT SIX COLUMNS FOUR ROWS (24 equal256x256 cells). Every figure roughly180px tall, same native miniature camera and scale throughout; all feet/robe contact at83% of their own cellheight.
ROW1: SIX distinct consecutive genuine WALK phases: left foot reaches/contacts, weight passes left with right knee lifted, right leg swings forward, right foot reaches/contacts, weight passes right with left knee lifted, left leg swings forward. Opposed natural arm motion and trailing robe folds. Complete ordinary walking cycle, not six idle stands.
ROW2: first FOUR actual FIDGET phases checking/touching the metal cloak clasp and belt-vial fastener then returning to guard; FIFTH ordinary calm RIGHT-facing IDLE; SIXTH same identity calm idle spare.
ROW3: first FOUR HIT RECOIL phases: sharp torso recoil, deeper bent-knee reaction with raised hand, forward recovery, nearly settled guard. LASTTWO calm idle spares.
ROW4: first FOUR TURN toward viewer poses:1 RIGHT-facing3/4,2 torso turns partly toward viewer with pivoting feet,3 nearly frontal,4 FULL FRONTAL with both shoulders visible. No back-facing body. LASTTWO frontal spare poses.
